The '''Millicreep''' was an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] used by the [[Umbaran militia]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] at [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. It was about a foot and a half long and was easy to transport when deactivated. Unleashed by a company of Umbaran Militia when they ambushed a [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], one of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] killed numerous clones with its electrified tail before being destroyed by General Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Known units==
*[[Amelie]]

==Behind the scenes==
Although ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' introduces the Millicreep as a [[Species/Legends|species]], the original [http://starwars.com/explore/encyclopedia/groups/umbarans Encyclopedia "Umbaran" entry] established that they were droids.
